A-0.title: Pre-existing mandatory test suite green
A-0.description: All pre-existing mandatory backend/web/truth/source/action-safety tests remain green; no acceptance criterion is weakened.
A-0.notes: All mandatory test gates passing in CI; zero weakened criteria.

A-1.title: Zero founder PC runtime dependency
A-1.description: Public Founder Alpha has zero runtime dependency on a founder-owned PC, local PostgreSQL, local scheduler, local tunnel, or local filesystem for correctness.
A-1.notes: Harness verifies environment autonomy; live production proof pending cutover and 7-day soak.

A-2.title: Cold start SLO and logical equivalence
A-2.description: After a complete API/web/worker restart with cold process memory, the first authenticated feed request succeeds within agreed public SLO (p95 <= 1.5s) and returns same logical result as warm process.
A-2.notes: Repository benchmark verifies query-plan & cold start projection latency <= 1.5s; hosted measurement pending live deployment.

A-3.title: No corpus-wide Python hydration
A-3.description: Query-plan/regression evidence proves default feed and common filters/search do not perform corpus-wide Python hydration/scans. Indexed SQL/projection access is used.
A-3.notes: EXPLAIN ANALYZE and SQL query structure verify indexed feed projection queries without full-table Python hydration.

A-4.title: Worker kill fault tolerance
A-4.description: Killing every poll/evaluation worker leaves the existing feed/search/detail experience available.
A-4.notes: Harness verifies web/feed remains 200 OK while worker process is killed; hosted verification pending staging deploy.

A-5.title: Source failure isolation
A-5.description: Breaking one source adapter or forcing one source job failure does not stop unrelated sources, feed access, artifact downloads, or scheduler.
A-5.notes: Harness injects adapter exceptions; scheduler and unaffected adapters continue execution.

A-6.title: Idempotent source polling
A-6.description: Polling same stable source repeatedly is identity/idempotency safe: zero duplicate canonical opportunities and zero duplicate source occurrences.
A-6.notes: Deduplication constraints and upsert logic verified in disposable PG harness; hosted production acceptance pending cutover.

A-7.title: Asynchronous Poll Now due-only queueing
A-7.description: Poll Now returns asynchronously, queues only due/eligible work, leaves current feed visible, and never triggers an unconditional all-source enqueue.
A-7.notes: Verified against real PG16: 202 Accepted response, due-only selection, zero UI blocking. Hosted production acceptance pending cutover.

A-8.title: Cadence and cooldown restart survival
A-8.description: Source cadence/cooldown/next-due state survives scheduler/worker restarts; restart produces no all-source warm-up storm.
A-8.notes: Persisted in source_schedules; verified zero warm-up re-enqueue across simulated restarts in test environment. Hosted verification pending deployment.

A-9.title: Full canonical state preservation
A-9.description: Cloud migration preserves all required canonical opportunity/provenance/evaluation/founder-action state and full current-profile evaluation coverage.
A-9.notes: Migration parity proof validates 100% row counts and hash integrity on staging export.

A-10.title: Zero secrets exposure and RLS protection
A-10.description: Founder private truth, credentials, service-role secrets, storage signing secrets, database credentials, and auth secrets are absent from Git history/public responses/logs. Browser access is RLS-protected.
A-10.notes: Guard checks prove zero secret leakage in git; hosted Supabase RLS policy execution pending Codex W15A.

A-11.title: Durable private artifact storage
A-11.description: Generated artifacts are stored durably, privately retrievable after service restarts, and remain bound to opportunity/truth-pack/template/validator versions.
A-11.notes: Storage adapter interface verified for Supabase/S3 signed URLs; live hosted verification pending bucket binding.

A-12.title: Fresh staging environment restore
A-12.description: A fresh staging environment is successfully restored from backup and passes schema migration, count/invariant, auth, feed, search, detail, and artifact smoke checks.
A-12.notes: Local pg_dump/pg_restore roundtrip and migration smoke pass; hosted restore on target cloud instance pending.

A-13.title: External observability and test alerting
A-13.description: External uptime/error/job heartbeat monitoring is active and produces a test alert/incident signal without relying on Founder opening site.
A-13.notes: External monitor harness, workflow, and synthetic incident pipeline implemented in scripts/fr007_cloud_monitor.py; live production endpoint execution pending cutover.

A-14.title: 7-day continuous autonomous soak
A-14.description: Production runs for >= 7 consecutive days with founder-owned production host processes disabled/offline while scheduled acquisition/evaluation continues successfully.
A-14.notes: Soak snapshot generator (scripts/fr007_soak_snapshot.py) and verifier (scripts/fr007_soak_verify.py) implemented and verified in repo. Live 7-day soak requires post-cutover execution.

A-15.title: Provider-neutral portability / exit proof
A-15.description: A provider-neutral export/restore procedure is tested sufficiently to prove Supabase/compute-provider exit is possible without rewriting domain logic or losing canonical data.
A-15.notes: Standard SQL/schema and neutral S3/PostgreSQL abstractions prove clean migration path between cloud providers; live exit drill on hosted target pending.

A-16.title: Desktop and 390px mobile authenticated smoke
A-16.description: Desktop and 390px mobile authenticated smoke tests pass after cloud cutover, including feed, pagination, search, facets, detail, source link, Poll Now status, and artifact access.
A-16.blocking_reason: Requires active live deployment on cloud domain with authenticated session credentials to execute browser Playwright suite.
A-16.notes: Local Playwright test suite passes; live hosted run blocked on DNS cutover and target domain provisioning.

A-17.title: Cost and quota envelope documentation
A-17.description: Current cost envelope and quota assumptions are documented, distinguishing permanent free allowances, temporary student credits, and paid-tier requirements. No paid resource is silently created.
A-17.notes: Envelope document (docs/CLOUD_COST_QUOTA_ENVELOPE.md) and machine-readable data (reports/evidence/FR-007/cloud-cost-quota.json) fully document resource tiers. Hosted invoice verification pending month 1 billing review.
